_purpose: Challenge-mastery RL for the Expansion + flow setup. The SFT parent supplies trade mastery (management measured at 0.92); this stage adds the 27 account/challenge fields and learns skip/enter under prop constraints — the decision SFT structurally cannot make, because the trade_mastery guard forbids account.* and challenge.* in its prompt. This mirrors algoTraderAI, whose PPO also only chose skip/enter and hold/close on top of a fixed timing+side rule.
